questions: How might the motivation for our instrumentation scheme and the continuous monitoring of models contribute to a deeper understanding of the scientific objectives of the two surveys?
In what ways could the isotropic radiation assumption of Fast Radio Bursts be reconciled with their potential origins in regions similar to those harboring masers or megamasers?
What is the nature of the mechanisms underlying the emission of Fast Radio Bursts?
How might the proposed framework for Fast Radio Bursts influence our understanding of their future daily observations?
Could the characteristics of Fast Radio Bursts and their associated afterglows be better explained by alternative models that challenge the prevailing isotropic radiation assumption?
